**Flag and inspect stage drift manually before multi-timepoint tracking.** Visible coordinate shifts across the sequence may accumulate to >5 µm; apply a frame-by-frame drift-correction estimate (e.g., cross-correlation of t=0 to later frames) before linking across timepoints to avoid false track breaks.
